notes: I Went Walking by Sue Williams (illustrated by Julie Vivas) is a repetitive cumulative pattern book where a child goes walking and sees a series of farm animals each identified by colour: a brown horse, a red cow, a yellow duck, a green frog, a pink pig, and a black cat. The 11 fringe words prioritise the six animals plus five of the six colours (green/frog omitted to stay within 11 slots — consider swapping pig or brown for green if the class focuses on colours). The hero is a generic young child so no specialist sourcing is needed. The strong colour-animal pairing makes this board ideal for colour-matching activities alongside the book.
